verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no built-in AI assistant inside SharePoint that a user can delegate tasks to. The only AI-related item is a developer-docs line about building Copilot UX components with SharePoint Framework. That is a developer building block, not a shipped in-product assistant, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Build Copilot UX components, web parts, extensions, and business solutions with SharePoint Framework and Microsoft 365.
